goal: Recreate the feel and motion of Slack's desktop app as shown in the reference screenshot: the purple sidebar and channel list, message hover actions, the compose box, and the exact easing curves, durations and colors of its transitions. Use data-testid attributes: sidebar, sidebar-item, channel-list, message, message-hover-actions, compose-box, unread-indicator.
summary: Build a static web page that reproduces the Slack-like purple sidebar, channel list, message list with hover actions, and compose box, matching the reference screenshot's colors, spacing, and transition easing/durations, with the specified data-testid attributes for verification.

checks.title: Sidebar has purple background matching Slack
Active channel item has blue background
checks.criteria: active sidebar item background color equals #2E5C9A

checks.title: Sidebar item hover transition duration and easing
checks.criteria: sidebar item background transition completes within 130-170ms

checks.title: Message hover actions appear on hover
checks.criteria: message-hover-actions is visible after hovering a message

checks.title: Message hover actions fade-in duration
checks.criteria: message-hover-actions opacity transitions from 0 to 1 within 100-140ms

checks.title: Compose box present with correct styling
checks.criteria: compose-box exists with border-radius 8px and border color #CCD6DD

checks.title: Unread indicator dot present on Activity item
checks.criteria: unread-indicator is visible on the Activity sidebar item

checks.title: Channel list contains expected channels
checks.criteria: channel-list contains sales-support, enablement, pipeline-planning, general, announcements

checks.title: No console errors on page load
Overall visual match to reference screenshot
checks.criteria: Layout, colors, spacing, and motion feel match the Slack reference screenshot (sidebar, channel list, messages, compose box)

environment.rationale: A headless Chromium browser in a Linux VM is needed to render the static page and verify DOM styles, transitions, and visual match. No GPU, desktop, or macOS is required. CRUSOE_API_KEY and NTFY_TOPIC are always present but not strictly needed for this static page goal.

design_facts: Sidebar background: #4C337C (purple). Active channel item background: #2E5C9A (blue). Sidebar width: 280px. Sidebar item height: 44px, hover transition 150ms ease-out. Message hover actions fade in 120ms ease-out on message hover. Compose box: rounded rectangle with light gray border, send button and attachment button. Font: system-ui / -apple-system / BlinkMacSystemFont / 'Segoe UI' / Roboto. Unread indicator: small dot, active channel has blue left border. Channel list items: # sales-support (active), enablement, pipeline-planning, general, announcements.
